issue_context.title: HomeKit: Cover of device_class 'door' should appear as door in the Home app
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Currently, when adding a cover template with the `device_class` set to `door`, the device that appears in the Apple Home app has a window covering icon. HomeKit has a dedicated [Door accessory](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/homekit/hmaccessorycategorytypedoor) category however, which under the hood acts like a window covering but appears in the app as a door (with several different icons to choose from). Example:

![IMG_5703B2CB1B9C-1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/521176/193275743-8f6a88da-f5e3-439d-82c0-0f0866f8f98d.png)

It would be really great if this integration could be tweaked so that templates set up this way show up with the door device type and icon in HomeKit.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.9.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

HomeKit

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
cover:
  - platform: template
    covers:
      bathroom_door:
        entity_id: cover.bathroom_door
        unique_id: "bathroom_door"
        device_class: door
        friendly_name: "Bathroom Door"
        value_template: "{{ is_state('switch.shelly_bathroom', 'on') }}"
        open_cover:
          service: switch.turn_on
          target: 
            entity_id: switch.shelly_bathroom
        close_cover:
          service: switch.turn_off
          target:
            entity_id: switch.shelly_bathroom
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
